notes:
Context:
- SMB inbound from sales enablement/call-summary tool. App attaches meta to each call (caller, callee, company, call transcript).
- Primary motion: self-serve sign-up, free credits for POC, move to paid monthly plan if satisfied.

Key asks / constraints (from legal & engineering):
- PII handling: need guidance on best practice for redaction (names, emails, credit card numbers). "We can't store raw PII beyond what's required."
- Retention: want configurable retention windows (30/90/365), immediate deletion API for user requests, and audit logs showing deletes.
- Encryption & keys: preference for provider-managed keys for now but asked if KMS/HSM available later.
- SSO: they use Okta; asked about SSO for Console and RBAC.

Technical priorities:
- Workload: near-real-time call summaries, 200–400 calls/day, peak concurrency ~6–10 requests/sec.
- Latency: comfortable with 300–700ms token generation; important for UX on the web app.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; wants batching suggestions to lower per-token cost. Mentioned they will try Redwood Optimize suggestions.
- Model preference: prefer open models; asked about fallback to smaller quantized variants when cost/latency tradeoffs needed.

Sales shorthand / quotes:
- "We need to be able to say 'we delete it if the user requests' — legal won't accept fuzzy answers."
- "If you can show how to redact PII before storing, that's a go."

Action items (internal):
- Send concise PII redaction guide + example code (client-side & server-side).
- Confirm deletion API contract and retention toggles for Hosted API.
- Share SOC2 summary + DPA template.
- Offer 30-day credit for POC and quick onboarding checklist.
- Ask engineering to prepare simple data flow diagram for legal (sample with hosted_api pipeline).

POC success criteria (customer):
- End-to-end: ingest calls -> generate summary -> store sanitized summary -> deletion flow works end-to-end for a sample user.
- Latency under 800ms for summary endpoints at their expected concurrency.
- Clear audit trail for retention/deletes.

Notes tone is short, fragments, and replicates what AE/SE wrote after calls.
